RimHex.HexAscensionDef.description: Every 10s, heal 1.2 treatable injury points on the nearest other colonist within 8 cells, if their health is below 70%.

RimHex.HexAscensionDef.label: Heavenpiercer · Awakening
RimHex.HexAscensionDef.description: When the Storm King's spear triggers, first strikes the original target for 500 + 200% of this hit's direct damage, then releases its normal storm. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexAscensionDef.label: Spreading storm · Awakening
RimHex.HexAscensionDef.description: The Storm King's spear storm expands to 8 cells and up to 16 enemies. Damage and cooldown are unchanged. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexAscensionDef.label: Forked arc · Reshaping
RimHex.HexAscensionDef.description: A successful attack arcs to up to two nearby enemies for 4% of its damage, capped at 6 each. Cooldown: 4s.

RimHex.HexAscensionDef.label: Focused charge · Reshaping
RimHex.HexAscensionDef.description: Three hits on the same enemy within 5s deal an extra 8% of the last hit, capped at 10. Cooldown: 3s.

RimHex.HexAscensionDef.label: Returning current · Reshaping
RimHex.HexAscensionDef.description: When no other enemy is near the target, a hit grants a shield worth 10% of its damage, capped at 10, for 4s. Cooldown: 5s.

RimHex.HexAscensionDef.label: Conductive escort · Reshaping
RimHex.HexAscensionDef.description: A hit shields the nearest other colonist within 8 cells for 2, lasting 5s. Cooldown: 5s.

RimHex.HexAscensionDef.label: Kindling scar · Resonance
RimHex.HexAscensionDef.description: A successful attack applies 0.05 burn levels. Cooldown: 5s.

RimHex.HexAscensionDef.label: Ashen mantle · Resonance
RimHex.HexAscensionDef.description: Your burn damage grants a personal shield worth 25% of the damage, capped at 8, lasting 4s. Cooldown: 5s.

RimHex.HexAscensionDef.label: Shared shelter · Resonance
